parameters.steps: Connectivity Map -> Drug sensitivity prediction -> Combination therapy

detailed_description:
Connectivity Map+药物敏感性+联合用药预测

适用场景: disease, tumor, 有药敏数据

分析步骤:
  - Connectivity Map: cmapPy gene set enrichment
  - Drug sensitivity prediction: oncoPredict IC50
  - Combination therapy: DrugComb synergy

依赖包: pRRophetic, cmapPy, oncoPredict, GSVA

难度: advanced

触发提示: "预测药物响应"
when_to_use: 适用于: disease, tumor, 有药敏数据
